messages:
liz_sales: Hey team — Tailwind (large retail analytics co) asked for a POC with Dedicated capacity + 24/7 support, expected 3 months. They want a 35% off list rate for the POC. Need deal-desk thumbs up or alternative structure. TL;DR: 3mo POC, est $150k list, asking 35% off.
aj_ae: Do we have committed follow-on likelihood? Any exec sponsor?
liz_sales: Yes — VP Product verbally committed to a 12mo rollout if POC passes (targeting Q4). They said they'd sign a 1yr reserved capacity after POC. Not contractually locked.
kelly_dealdesk: 35% is above the auto-approve threshold. Need justification doc: expected ARR conversion %, competitor pricing signal, and margin impact. Can you paste the POC SOW + expected renewal probability? :clipboard:
samir_se: Technical note — POC requires dedicated gpus w/ kv-cache and real-time latency SLOs. We'll need a small staging cluster and can pare back memory/replicas to reduce cost during POC. I can provide an optimized config that reduces list by ~12%.
nina_finance: Please run curt margin calc. If list $150k -> 35% off = $97.5k net. Need expected gross margin after infra & support. If conversion to 1yr reserved is 70%+, we can consider uplift via commit credits rather than straight discount.
liz_sales: Conversion estimate we gave the customer is 60-75% but that's squishy. They are price-sensitive.
pricing-bot: Auto-check: 35% exceeds Deal Desk policy for mid-market. Requires VP Sales + Head of Finance approval. Attachments required: SOW, ROI deck, competitor comps.
kelly_dealdesk: Option A: Approve 20% off for POC, with a convertible commit clause: if they sign 12mo reserved within 90 days post-POC, credit remaining discount up to 30% (effectively rebate). Option B: Approve 35% if they sign a minimum 12mo commit at day 0. Which can you get?
aj_ae: They won't sign day 0. So Option A is better. Can we add a usage cap for the POC to limit downside?
samir_se: Yes — cap tokens and peak qps. We can also offer staged autoscale but billed only for baseline nodes, with overage charged. I can draft the config limits.
liz_sales: I'll push Option A. Need the legal language for the convertible credit + an end date for credit. devon_legal — can you draft an addendum (short) for convertible credit and caps?
devon_legal: I can. Quick Q: does the credit require dollar-for-dollar refund or credit applied to future invoices? Preference is credit to future invoices to avoid revenue reversal. Confirm which.
nina_finance: Credit to future invoices is preferred. We'll need to model revenue recognition.
kelly_dealdesk: Also need an exec sign-off because this is above 25% for strategic deals. @vp_sales please review when I post materials.
liz_sales: Uploading SOW + ROI deck now. I'll also include competitor pricing screenshot.
aj_ae: One more ask — can we add a clause that if they don't convert within 90 days, we can offer a 10% extension for 1 more month to finish evaluation? Helps close.
devon_legal: Fine, will put a 90-day conversion window + single 30-day extension option.
kelly_dealdesk: Good. Once SOW + ROI + margin calc are in, I'll route to VP Sales + Nina for approval. If both approve, we can sign option A as a special term.
liz_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll add docs and ping again. :sparkles:
